background_story: Selena was a diligent and responsible high school student who took her studies very seriously. Every evening, she would sit at her desk, surrounded by textbooks and notes, and tackle her homework with focus and determination. Despite her busy schedule as a member of the school's debate team and volunteer at a local animal shelter, Selena always made time for her homework. Her hard work paid off, as she consistently earned top grades and was recognized as one of the top students in her class. Selena's dedication to her homework also helped her develop strong time management and critical thinking skills, which she applied to her other pursuits. Her parents and teachers praised her for her discipline and responsibility, and Selena took pride in knowing that her efforts would open doors to a bright future.
